option_relations.rationale: Lobular capillary hemangioma (pyogenic granuloma) does not match the histopathological and genetic findings described in the vignette.
Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation is a specific type of acquired tufted angioma, which matches the histopathological findings and genetic analysis in the vignette.
Acquired tufted angioma matches the histopathological findings and clinical presentation described in the vignette.
Microvenular hemangioma does not match the histopathological and genetic findings described in the vignette.
